Two operator rulings 2026-08-23 implemented in untracked/watch-fleet.sh, docs/infra/model-registry.md and tools/regression-watch-fleet.sh. RULING 1 (short model names on every human surface, rendered through ONE table): the hardcoded mdl() case statement is replaced by an awk lookup against the 'Short names → canonical' table in docs/infra/model-registry.md — watch-fleet holds no second mapping. A worker's argv can carry the short name (--dsflash startup alias), a canonical label (--model deepseek-v4-flash), a serving tag (--model glm-5.2:cloud, stealth/ox-alpha) or a prefix (qwen3.8); a model string matches a row when it equals, prefixes, or is prefixed by the row's short/canonical/serving-tag cell, and unknown models fall back to the pre-colon prefix (a rendering fallback, not a map). Two mdl() authoring defects were caught during the red run: awk's exit still runs the END block, so the fallback printed after a match (fixed with a found flag), and an empty model string matched every row via index(s,'')==1 (fixed with an m != '' guard). The registry itself was updated per the ruling: the flash short name renamed flash -> dsflash and an oxalpha row added (| `oxalpha` | `ox-alpha` | `stealth/ox-alpha` |); prose and the table header annotation updated to note the T739 ruling. Result: flash renders dsflash, stealth/ox-alpha renders oxalpha, and no canonical label or serving tag can reach the model column (arm J asserts the column is hyphen/colon/slash-free). RULING 2 (fill the screen): the layout reserve was 2k+6 — the pre-T738 constant that still banked the banner's 3 lines — so a data-rich frame left blank rows while DONE/OPEN had rows left to show. Replaced with exact accounting: k headings + (k-1) separators + 2-line footer + 1 spare (footer never scrolls off) + 1 '(more)' per flexible section whose rows exceed its MIN_ROWS floor; avail is floored at 0. Every line recovered becomes a visible row: arm K pins a 40-row terminal with 20 DONE + 20 OPEN at 16+16 rows shown / 37-line one-shot frame (old: 15+15 / 35); the interactive frame adds the 2-line footer = 39 <= 40 with the spare.
